mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points and a decline in nonfarm payrolls above 50,000 signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
